_comment: Local interfaces that a device can answer on (api_source of the scan). api_types: which group the answer points to and how much it weighs ('declared' = a declared fact; a number = that many points). An IoT answer says 'smart device', not what it does, so it only feeds the platform clue. platform_adapters: the beginnings of the names of the adapters whose answer comes from the direct API of an IoT platform.
